body:
#4308 (STORY-2905 S1t-b) round 3 pushed: head 92a90e2, ready for light re-review.

CI-fix scope only. CI lib-0 was red on admission_owner story2857_cross_process_worker_blocks_land_and_manual (and its child, story2857_process_contender): the fixture's bare .git had no default branch, so the fail-closed landing-policy check refused before admission. Fix: the fixture builds a real repo (main + empty commit). The check itself is unchanged.
Also: pr_train_journal_killed_merge_and_eject_resume_without_replay now spawns its crash child from the test image (aida_bin::current_executable_path) instead of aida_exe_path(), which resolves the installed aida on dev hosts (exit 2). CI was green on that test either way.
check-ci-fast exit 0; relabeled ci:full. The diff since round 2 is b35b3b5..92a90e2 (2 test files).
After the merge I cut promotion 23 (S1c + S1t-a + S1t-b). Note the implementer grant expired at 15:44 UTC.
